_schema._comment: POPULATE THIS FILE with one entry per unique supplierName from mid-year-2026-supplier.json.
_schema._supplierName: REQUIRED. Must match the supplierName in mid-year-2026-supplier.json exactly (case-insensitive trimmed match).
_schema._canonicalName: REQUIRED. Research-proposed canonical name. If unknown, leave as empty string — the ingestion script will use supplierName as provisional.
_schema._brand: REQUIRED. Research-proposed canonical brand. If unknown, leave as empty string.
_schema._launchYear: OPTIONAL. Year the fragrance was launched. Integer.
_schema._sourceConfidence: REQUIRED. One of: 'high', 'medium', 'low'. Reflects Gemini's certainty about the canonical identity.
_schema._sourceNotes: OPTIONAL. Free-text notes from Gemini research.
_schema._possibleNameIssue: REQUIRED boolean. true if the supplier name differs from the canonical name in a way that needs editorial review.
_schema._nameIssueExplanation: OPTIONAL. Required when possibleNameIssue is true. Explain the discrepancy.
_schema._knowledgeFields: fragranceFamily, topNotes, heartNotes, baseNotes, mainAccords, perfumer are preserved here for future Knowledge Factory use. They are NOT ingested into the IdentityRecord.

_confidenceGuide.high: Research is certain: canonical name, brand, and launch year all verified from multiple sources.
_confidenceGuide.medium: Plausible canonical proposal but one detail is uncertain or sources conflict.
_confidenceGuide.low: Research could not verify the exact fragrance — supplier terminology may be ambiguous.

_example.sourceNotes: Iconic Hermès floral; canonical name confirmed across Fragrantica and brand website.
_example.nameIssueExplanation: Supplier lists brand in the name ('Hermes 24 Faubourg') but canonical name is '24 Faubourg' without the brand prefix.
